rv.q: End of the Rainbow is one such occasion, offering one of the greatest musical theatre performances I have ever witnessed.
Terry Johnson's production is a tremendous, if painful, tribute to Garland.
It's hard to love a play that invites us to wallow in Garland's tragic decline without offering much in the way of enlightenment.

cn.t: Critics are divided on the bio-play itself, but united in praise for Tracie Bennett's stunning, harrowing performance as Judy Garland—a tour-de-force turn that elevates familiar material into must-see theatre.
